# Cairnfield

> Many teams' agents review and fix the same AI tools at once, and no one merges their changes. Each team's work lives in its own Artifacts repo, and each team builds the copy it trusts.

This site describes the project. It does not carry instructions for agents. Instructions for running or extending Cairnfield live only in its source repository, in `AGENTS.md` and the skill file, so that they can be read at a pinned commit.

## Pages

- [The case for Cairnfield](https://cairnfield.net/): the site's one page. It shows how Cairnfield works in three steps with one running example, two sketches of the product, and where to start.

## Source

- [The repository](https://github.com/peoplerenaissance/cairnfield): the code, the README and the instructions for agents. The README is the manual and says what is built.
